messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — ACME renewal ~6 weeks out. I spotted a big uptick in token burn since their onboarding pilot. Need a short QBR-ready packet: 90d spend forecast (3 scenarios), renewal risk signal, and a targeted enablement plan to reduce unit cost. Owners: @Ravi (numbers), @Priya (enablement), @Alex (renewal ask). Deliverables by Thu EOD please.

Ravi (FinOps): On it. Pulling last 30 days now. Quick snapshot: avg 2.1M tokens/day, spike to ~4.8M/day last 48h (embeddings pipeline). If current rate holds, rough 90d spend ~ $72k. I'll produce three scenariOS: baseline, if they patch embeddings, and if we reduce tokens by 15%.

Ravi (FinOps): Running query against usage DB: ```sql
SELECT date, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage
WHERE account = 'acme'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 90;
```
Results look noisy — embeddings job at 03:00 UTC is the main contributor.

Sam (Customer): Yep that embeddings job was misconfigured. We ramped it up accidentally during the pilot ingest. We'll throttle tonight and push a fix. What's the recommended batch size? :grimacing:

Priya (Enablement): Great — if you can throttle that's huge. Recommend short plan: 1) 1-hour workshop on prompt engineering + caching, 2) audit top 5 flows for token leaks, 3) implement prefix/KV caching and batching. Target 15% token reduction in 2 weeks. Example config suggestion: ```yaml
batching:
  batch_size: 64
  max_seq: 2048
prefix_cache: true
```

Alex (Account Exec): Quick commercial note — ACME still has $50k committed credits left from Dedicated pilot (expires in 30d). If we present a renewal with a 10% price lock + 1 week of paid enablement, likely to keep them. If cost projections stay high they may ask for steeper concession.

billing-bot: :warning: Budget alert triggered for account=acme — monthly allotment at 76%. Tagged: renewal_risk. See /billing/alerts/1938881234

Ravi (FinOps): I'll attach a short spreadsheet with assumptions for the 3 scenarios (current, patch, optimize). Early numbers: baseline 90d = $72k, patch = $46k, optimized = $38.5k. Will also include per-token unit cost breakdown and rolling average latencies.

Maya (CSM): Action items: Ravi -> forecast + assumptions doc; Priya -> schedule 1-hr enablement workshop & draft audit checklist; Alex -> draft renewal proposal (10% price lock + enablement PS). Sam -> confirm embedding patch rollout ETA (today). Sync Friday 10:00am PT to review deck.

Priya (Enablement): I'll create a short checklist: top prompt anti-patterns, places to add caching, and reuseable prompt templates. Will post before EOD tomorrow.

Sam (Customer): Patch ETA = 6pm PT today. Will repost once throttled. Thanks team.

Alex (Account Exec): I'll sketch the commercial language and pre-approve a $5k enablement credit to sweeten renewal.

Maya (CSM): Perfect. If Ravi can drop the initial forecast in the thread when ready that helps the deck. Thanks all :thumbsup:
